brevo.body:
Hey traveller,

Winter Escapes 2027 is open: three cities, planned by the crew that walks them. Our lowest prices guaranteed.

Copenhagen

Vienna
Christmas markets at dusk and long café afternoons.

Prague
Side streets, snowy rooftops and a bridge at sunrise.

Explore the winter collection: https://vamo-travel-site.vercel.app/winter.html

Go for the place. Stay for the people.

brevo.name: Winter Escapes 2027 · Vienna teaser
brevo.subject: Vienna in December, without the rush ☕️
brevo.previewText: Three slow days, one café at a time.
brevo.body:
Hey traveller,

Our Vienna winter break is built around one idea: never rush a café.

Day one: Christmas markets at dusk, then dinner at a long shared table.
Day two: one museum, the Ring by tram, and an evening at a concert hall standing area.
Day three: a slow breakfast before the train home.

Lowest prices guaranteed on every Vienna break this winter.

The Vamo crew

Three cities, planned by the people who walk them. Copenhagen: harbour mornings and a bakery on every corner. Vienna: slow cafés and Christmas markets at dusk. Prague: side streets and an early walk over the bridge.

Small groups, no rush, and plenty of open time between the plans.

Lowest prices guaranteed. Book before the end of October.
